in_marathi.name: Devmahansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of great strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devmahansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devmahansh is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Mahansh’ meaning great strength. This name signifies a strong and divine being. In Hindu mythology, Devmahansh is often associated with the god Shiva, who is known for his immense power and strength.
